# Source-exact ordinary COUNT capsule: n6.B0.p61

This directory bundles **29 unmodified native source/contract files** for the complete conditional COUNT job n6.B0.p61. The selected source bytes total 96135 bytes, so ordinary local reproduction does not need to download the 224 MB parent archive.

`capsule-manifest.json` records every original archive member, byte size and SHA256. Its independent SHA256 is frozen in `src/be/count_native.py`. `PROVENANCE.json`, this note and the MIT license are distribution metadata outside the executable mathematical source closure.

No historical forest or acceptance receipt is included as a runtime input. The historical forest pin remains in the provenance manifest; separate untrusted parser test data lives under `tests/fixtures/count_native`. The adapter freshly constructs a candidate in one directory and verifies it in another. All seven roots and both children of the two phase splits are required; the reproduced forest has nine leaves.

The exact scope is n=6, literal same-orientation p in [61/100,31/50], the full signed/physical resource contract in `contract.json`, and a strict positive closed-CDF score bound below the pinned target. `RIGHT_HALF_COUNT_PROOF.txt` is part of the frozen kernel closure. No reflection of closed events is introduced.

An accepted result is a conditional scoped source replay. It does not acquire the resource hypotheses and is not an all-law C6 or final all-index proof. See [the adapter plan](../../docs/implementation/COUNT-NATIVE-PLAN.md) for the statement, trust boundary and integration ports.

All native files retain their original bytes, including line endings. Do not reformat the Python or JSON files in this directory. The repository's attributes disable line-ending transformation for this capsule. The included MIT license is from the public source repository at commit `ad67ab9d8d770bd2a2b9b397bfbe484a3449f707`.
